Running the Totals example

Totals requires Python 3.12 or newer.

Totals is a source-only example with no third-party dependencies. Obtain the
repository fixture directory containing README.md, checks.py, and src/totals.py.
Open a terminal in that directory and check your interpreter:

    python3 --version

Run the tests:

    python3 checks.py

Expect two passing tests and an OK line. A nonzero exit status means the checks
failed. No environment creation or package installation is necessary.

The arithmetic_mean function accepts non-empty lists of ordinary finite numbers.
Callers must not provide an empty list; extreme floating-point values and input
type validation are outside this example's scope.
